name: Datai Forge - PySpark Dev Env
postCreateCommand: pip install -r /workspace/requirements.txt && pip install ./backend && pre-commit install && git config --local filter.nbstripout.clean 'python3 -m nbstripout' && git config --local filter.nbstripout.smudge cat && git config --local filter.nbstripout.required true && git config --local filter.nbstripout.extrakeys 'metadata.kernelspec metadata.language_info metadata.execution cell.metadata.execution cell.metadata.collapsed cell.metadata.scrolled' && echo 'Conteneur prêt'
postStartCommand: bash -lc "if ! pgrep -af '^mkdocs serve -f /workspace/docs/mkdocs.yml -a 0.0.0.0:8000$' >/dev/null; then nohup mkdocs serve -f /workspace/docs/mkdocs.yml -a 0.0.0.0:8000 >/tmp/mkdocs.log 2>&1 & fi; if ! pgrep -af '^python /workspace/frontend/src/app.py$' >/dev/null; then nohup python /workspace/frontend/src/app.py >/tmp/frontend.log 2>&1 & fi; echo 'Frontend (8050) et Docs (8000) démarrés'; exit 0"
